title: [review] local-fact: dataclasses.replace can desync claims from retained wire bstrs
description: Edge-case review of lquv fix (pass 3). python/src/lichen/gateway/local_facts.py LocalFact retains protected_bytes/payload_bytes (RFC 9052 4.4) but __post_init__ only enforces both-or-neither pairing, never that claims matches payload_bytes. On a frozen dataclass the idiomatic mutation is dataclasses.replace(fact, claims=...), which KEEPS the old wire bstrs: verify_local_fact(desynced) returns True (verified over the old signed payload) while desynced.claims carries unverified attacker-relevant fields (priority/quota/relay), and to_cose_sign1 emits the OLD payload contradicting .claims. The pre-lquv tamper-resistance property (mutate claims -> verify fails, per test_verify_rejects_tampered_claims) is silently lost on the replace-on-decoded-fact path. Verified against working tree. Fix: in __post_init__, when both wire bstrs are present, require LocalFactClaims.from_cbor(payload_bytes) == claims (cheap, exact, encoding-agnostic).
close_reason: Fixed the dataclasses.replace desync: LocalFact.__post_init__ now raises LocalFactError when both wire bstrs are present and LocalFactClaims.from_cbor(payload_bytes) != claims (decoded-equality, encoding-agnostic per the docstring contract). Also fixed 2 defects caught by delegated codereview pass 1: (1) channel normalized to tuple via object.__setattr__ in LocalFactClaims.__post_init__ (list-channel issuance false-rejected the guard); (2) added explicit 'wire bstrs must be bytes' isinstance check (TypeError leak on non-bytes). Added 4 tests: desync-rejected, matching-bstrs-accepted, list-channel-issue-accepted, non-bytes-bstr-rejected. Verified: 34 local_facts tests pass, 377 gateway suite pass, behavioral probe of all 3 fixes PASS, desync test non-vacuous (fails pre-fix). Codereview: pass1 (kimi-k3) found the 2 defects -> fixed; re-review pass2 (security) + pass3 (edge) via subagents: PASS + PASS (edge pass confirmed empty-channel/list-subclass/pickle-hash/copy all sound, encoding-agnosticism real, no construction path regresses). One cosmetic stale comment ('line 192') also corrected.
